summary: GoldMining Inc. filed a Form 6-K on May 15, 2026, reporting voting results from its annual meeting of shareholders held on May 14, 2026. The filing discloses the election of six director nominees and the appointment of auditor PricewaterhouseCoopers LLP, with a quorum of 27.04% of outstanding shares represented. No transaction, strategic review, activist campaign, or other special situation is announced. This is a routine corporate governance update and does not constitute a special-situation event.
